notes: Events are data (EVT-3, D-033). trigger.type: time | lateNight | absence | stat | streak | date | birthday | random | memory | diary | active | levelUp | weather (is: rain/storm/snow/clear/cloudy/hot/cold, optional hours). kind: chat | choice | quest | callback | nudge | diary. minBond = bond level index (0 Stranger .. 4 Soulmate). seed = what the chat brain writes a line from; lines = fallback when agy is unavailable. {name} = the Tama's name.
